summary: Retested backend+frontend M1 flows on public URL after login stall fix. Auth body delivery and history fidelity now load, but critical regressions remain in brute-force auth protection, CORS origin handling, and source-profile interaction binding.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout: after 5 invalid password attempts, valid login still succeeds with HTTP 200 instead of temporary refusal.
CORS preflight returns access-control-allow-origin as cluster emergentcf.cloud host instead of explicit requester origin, despite allow_credentials=true.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking source rows opens UNBOUND drawer ('no qualified effect is bound...') instead of opening Source Profile modal.
Horizontal overflow on mobile sources view; content extends beyond viewport and hides right-side text/rows.

integration_issues.issue: Source profile/schema/profile/relationships details are present in code path but unreachable from source rows due unbound click wiring.

issues: Right column content is clipped/partially hidden during normal reading.

action_items: Implement and enforce auth brute-force lockout policy (>=5 failed attempts) in /api/auth/login flow.
Fix CORS origin behavior for credentialed requests so Access-Control-Allow-Origin is explicit and stable to caller origin/domain policy.
Bind source catalogue row click to sourceInfo/open profile path (not onUnbound), so Source Profile modal opens with real table/profile/relationships data.
Fix mobile sources layout overflow/clipping at 390x844.
After fixes, rerun operator journey for Data Connected → Source profile → Compute/Models tabs/disclosures and mobile overflow checks.
critical_code_review_comments: operational_scope source_refs/worker/source-tenant guards are functioning correctly in live checks (wrong worker, cross-tenant source, bad source_refs, extra credential/shell keys all rejected).
descriptor_contracts import/runtime path is now healthy (iteration56 isolated contract suite passed).
Source catalogue UX still contains an active UNBOUND pathway, violating owner requirement to report and avoid noop/unbound critical actions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: History fidelity improved in this run: tabs Discovery Summary/GPU Spend/Conversation with Agent/Discovery Details present; Coverage/Condition/Readiness present; no 'Census #undefined'; cr-5938285cddbf and cr-f8086f961dcd visible with partial 6-of-7 text. Connect drawer flow works with existing rms_mysql declaration (idempotent 'already exists'). Remaining blocker: source rows open UNBOUND drawer instead of Source Profile modal.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 auth lockout: login path (routers/auth.py -> user_store.authenticate) performs plain credential verification with no failure counter/time-window state, so repeated failures never transition to lockout. RCA-2 CORS: credentialed preflight response returns a different canonical host origin (cluster emergentcf.cloud) than request origin, indicating origin normalization/mismatch in deployment CORS policy chain. RCA-3 source profile UI: source catalogue row click maps to unbound callback in rendered owner markup path, triggering global onUnbound drawer ('no qualified effect is bound') instead of registryEstate.sourceInfo -> registry-source-profile modal opening.
